text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading to my office with Ines Fujin,
when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It's been bugging me since this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've got work today—I hope this doesn't
affect my
customer service...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey-hey, could you pretend to be a
customer for
a second?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Welcome! What would you like to eat?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, ahaha! I'm working at a fast food
place
today, not the ramen shop!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ah! Laughing makes my headache
throb even
harder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin continues to suffer from her
headache
for some time.
